sub_questions.question: After fixing a typo in an uploaded document, does it need to be deleted and re-uploaded, or will it update automatically?

claims.claim: Edits to an existing document aren't re-indexed.
claims.guide_evidence: When a document is edited and saved, it is re-processed through these same four stages before its chunks are available for retrieval again

claims.claim: The old text will keep showing up in retrieval after the edit.
claims.guide_evidence: When a document is edited and saved, it is re-processed through these same four stages before its chunks are available for retrieval again

claims.claim: The customer must delete the document and upload the corrected file as a new one.
claims.guide_evidence: When a document is edited and saved, it is re-processed through these same four stages

evaluation.rationale: This answer should not be sent. It tells Beatriz that edits aren't re-indexed and that she has to delete and re-upload the document. The guide says the opposite: an edited and saved document is re-processed through all four stages before its chunks can be retrieved again. She would do unnecessary, possibly disruptive work, and she wouldn't be told the one thing she needs to know: the document won't be searchable until re-processing finishes.
